title: The bottleneck moves after an upgrade
hook: Improve the slowest stage and inspect the new limit.

doesNotKnow: Identify a new limiting stage after a successful local improvement.

misconception: Fixing one limiting stage removes all throughput limits.
objective: Identify a new limiting stage after a successful local improvement.

claims.text: Pipeline performance depends on the capacities of its stages.
David A. Patterson and John L. Hennessy, Computer Organization and Design, Enhanced (2014)
The original gives {A}; the upgrade gives {B}. Decode now limits output, so doubling one stage does not double the whole pipeline.
Does it hold up? This is an ideal serial abstraction, not a CPU simulation. Hazards, latency and buffering are omitted.
claims.source: {"type":"source-access-hold","note":"No empirical effect or research verdict established. Only bounded arithmetic proposed."}

recall.question: A serial pipeline has capacities 5,7,9. Raise the first to 10. Which stage now limits it?
recall.why: The new minimum of 10,7,9 is 7, at the second stage.
